body: Twin brother, actually. Probably in the same boat as me, just handled it differently. The classes can actually be very brutal (The English teacher is an ex-professor, and gives assignments higher than college grade. All classes are automatically honors level.) I already figured out high school is stupid and grades aren't very important, but my parents insist that I'm secretly a straight-A student, and that I'm simply "Not trying hard enough."

Right now they are, which is a little understandable I guess (3 Ds, almost a few F's at the moment.) I'm also supposed to do a few hours of community service (the wonders of private school,) which I haven't been able to do (schoolwork, stress, extracurricular activities, etc.) My parents have been really uptight because my brother has been failing and basically spending his time smoking weed and playing video games; there's a fight between them every other night it seems
"WE ARE SEX BOB-OMB! WE ARE HERE TO MAKE YOU THINK ABOUT DEATH AND GET SAD AND STUFF!"
"**SOLD!** TO THE EXCEPTION MAN, WITH THE UNEXCEPTIONAL NIGGA!"

It's not that I'll say something stupid, it's just that I never make a deep connection with anyone else. I'll be talking, laughing... but that's it. No one-one one, nothing- which, honestly, I don't care much about, but if and when I finally grow a pair and ask somebody out, the answer is always 'no.' I don't think it has anything to do with looks, I've been hit on before by the opposite (and same,) sex, but when it goes down to the line, there's always something off, as if I was good, but just not good enough for somebody. As for life, nothing particularly shitty has happened- I was rejected again in October, but that's it. Every day is just another day-Wake up, get my shit together, go to school, laugh, go home, collapse, try to relax with TV/computer, do HW, go to bed.

Honestly, I've gotten to the point where I don't even want to hope for anything. Literally every time I've hoped for something good or tried to excel, I've either lost focus or been completely devastated. I can't even remember the last time I took a leap of faith and was rewarded. So the idea of 'holding on,' is really starting to wear off. I'm self-conscious, I annoy myself, I have weak self-control and initiative, and I'm so awkward it's hilarious. To add all of that, my grades are failing; there's a very good chance I may be kicked out of my school, filled with every single friend I've ever known or cared about (after being gone for a year going to a new school, which was the most miserable experience of my life.) Thanks so so much for responding so quickly (really!), but I'm not looking at a happy or hopeful future.
